verdict.rationale: A runtime probe shows @babylonjs/core is published under Apache-2.0, and the docs describe it as an "open" engine. A permissive open-source license with no runtime fees structurally prevents repricing of games already shipped. The pack offers no history of license stability over time and no statement about future terms. Community praise for backwards compatibility concerns the API, not licensing, so it is not credited here. missing for 10: documented license/pricing history showing no changes over time, explicit first-party licensing page or commitment, independent corroboration of license stability.
